name: Progress ring
description: Progress as a ring that fills clockwise from the top: a focus timer, a daily goal, a habit's week, a small upload next to a file name. Determinate (--ayy-value 0–100) or indeterminate, with an optional value, time or icon in the middle.

classes.ayy-progress-ring: Root: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max, an accessible name and --ayy-value (0–100). Clockwise from the top in every direction, like a clock. 2.5rem.
classes.ayy-progress-ring__svg: First child: <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" aria-hidden="true"> holding the track and the bar circles (cx=18 cy=18 r=16 pathLength=100). progressRingSvg is the markup.
classes.ayy-progress-ring__track: The full circle behind the fill.
classes.ayy-progress-ring__bar: The fill: a round-capped arc as long as --ayy-value. Hidden at aria-valuenow="0".
classes.ayy-progress-ring__label: Optional, in the middle: the value ("3/5"), a time, or an Icon. Scales with the ring; leave it out at sm.
classes.ayy-progress-ring--sm: 1.25rem, next to a line of text.
classes.ayy-progress-ring--xl: Up to 16rem (70% of a phone's width): a timer.
classes.ayy-progress-ring--indeterminate: A quarter arc going round (still under reduced motion); omit aria-valuenow and --ayy-value.

default.looks: A 10% text-colour track and a round-capped arc in the text colour, starting at the top and running clockwise to --ayy-value.

hover.none: Not interactive. Wrap it in a button if it starts or pauses something.

focus.none: Not focusable; it's a progressbar that screen readers read. Put focus on the control next to it.

disabled.none: Not interactive. A paused timer stays at its value; say "Paused" in the label.

error.looks: The arc turns the destructive colour. Say what failed next to it, not only with colour.

loading.looks: A quarter arc spins; under reduced motion it stays still, so say what's happening in a label.

empty.looks: Only the track shows: no dot of arc at 0.

scale.sm: 20px, a thicker stroke: next to a file name or in a list row.
scale.md: 40px: a goal or a habit's day.
scale.xl: min(16rem, 70vw), a thin stroke and a lighter label: a focus timer's whole screen.

sizes.density: Doesn't change with data-density; pick a size.
sizes.width: Square at its size; the label in the middle scales with it.

js: progressRingClass({ variant?, size?, indeterminate?, className? }) → string; progressRingSvg (the SVG markup to put first inside the ring); progressRingSizes. The fill colour can be overridden with --ayy-progress-color, as on Progress.
a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow/min/max (React sets them). Give it a name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
What the label in the middle says isn't read (a progressbar's content is presentational): put it in the name too ("Habit: 3 of 5 days this week").
The fill is drawn with the system highlight in High Contrast, the track in GrayText.
do: Use a ring where a circle means something or a bar has no room: a timer, a daily goal, a habit's week, a file's upload in a list row.
Put the number or time in the middle at md and up; next to the ring at sm.
Use success when a goal is reached, with a tick in the middle.
dont: Don't use a ring for a long task's progress across a page — a Progress bar reads more precisely.
Don't use an indeterminate ring where a Spinner fits (a button, a small area).
Don't nest rings for several values; use a Chart.
